hero.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Iranian Chess School

whatIs.a: Iranian Chess School is a comprehensive online chess training platform with structured courses, live classes, game reviews, puzzles, and a supportive community. We help players from absolute beginners to 2000+ Elo improve their game.

whoAreCoaches.a: Our coaches are titled players including FIDE Masters and Woman Grandmasters with years of teaching experience. They provide personalized feedback and lead live group sessions.

needFarsi.q: Do I need to know Farsi?
needFarsi.a: No, all content is available in English. However, our coaches are fluent in both English and Farsi to serve our international community.

howMuch.a: We offer three plans: Standard ($29/mo), Premium ($49/mo), and VIP ($199/mo). We also have specialized kids plans. Annual billing gives you 2 months free.

freeTrial.a: Yes! We offer a 7-day free trial on all plans. No credit card required. You can cancel anytime during the trial at no cost.

cancel.a: Absolutely. You can cancel your subscription at any time. Your access continues until the end of your billing period. No cancellation fees.

liveClasses.a: Live group classes are held weekly via video conferencing. Each session focuses on specific themes and includes Q&A. Premium and VIP members get priority access.

gameReview.q: What is a game review session?
gameReview.a: You submit your game (PGN or Chess.com/Lichess link) and a coach analyzes it move-by-move, explaining mistakes, better alternatives, and key learning points.

oneOnOne.a: VIP members can book 1-on-1 sessions directly through our booking system. Premium members get monthly sessions. Sessions are conducted via video call.

timeNeeded.q: How much time do I need?
timeNeeded.a: We recommend 3–5 hours per week for optimal progress. This includes watching lessons, solving puzzles, playing games, and reviewing with coaches.

ownPace.q: Can I learn at my own pace?
ownPace.a: Yes! All course materials are available on-demand. You can watch lessons, solve puzzles, and study at whatever pace works for you.

improvement.q: How long until I see improvement?
improvement.a: Most students see noticeable improvement within 4–6 weeks of consistent training. Many gain 100–200 Elo in their first 3 months.

requirements.q: What do I need to get started?
requirements.a: A computer or tablet with internet access. For live classes, you need a camera and microphone. The platform works on all modern browsers.

importGames.q: Can I import games from Chess.com or Lichess?
importGames.a: Yes! You can import games from both Chess.com and Lichess by entering your username. We also support PGN file upload.

mobileApp.q: Do you have a mobile app?
mobileApp.a: The platform is fully responsive and works great on mobile browsers. A native mobile app is in development.
